items.source: Note: this is a mutable property.
items.translation: 注意：这是一个可变属性。

items.source: Since JUnit Jupiter 5.12, if the SpringExtension is used with a test-method scoped ExtensionContext, the Class returned from this method may refer to the test class for the current test method, which may be a @Nested test class within the class for the test instance. Thus, if you need consistent access to the class for the current test instance within an implementation of TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext), you should invoke testContext.getTestInstance().getClass() instead of testContext.getTestClass().
items.translation: 自 JUnit Jupiter 5.12 起，如果与 `test-method` 范围的ExtensionContext一起使用SpringExtension，此方法返回的`Class`可能引用当前测试方法的测试类，该测试类可能是测试实例所在类中的@Nested测试类。因此，如果您需要在`TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext)`的实现中一致地访问当前测试实例的类，您应该调用`testContext.getTestInstance().getClass()`而不是`testContext.getTestClass()`。

items.source: If this method returns true, a subsequent invocation of getApplicationContext() or markApplicationContextUnused() should succeed.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 `true`，则后续调用getApplicationContext()或markApplicationContextUnused()应成功。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, concrete implementations are highly encouraged to override setMethodInvoker(MethodInvoker) and getMethodInvoker().
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，强烈建议具体实现类重写setMethodInvoker(MethodInvoker)和getMethodInvoker()。

items.source: Concrete implementations should track the supplied MethodInvoker and return it from getMethodInvoker(). Note that the standard TestContext implementation in Spring overrides this method appropriately.
items.translation: 具体实现应跟踪提供的 `MethodInvoker`，并从getMethodInvoker()返回它。请注意，Spring 中的标准`TestContext` 实现已适当覆盖此方法。

items.source: Concrete implementations should return the MethodInvoker supplied to setMethodInvoker(MethodInvoker). Note that the standard TestContext implementation in Spring overrides this method appropriately.
items.translation: 具体实现应返回提供给setMethodInvoker(MethodInvoker)的MethodInvoker。请注意，Spring 中的标准TestContext实现已适当覆盖此方法。

items.source: The default implementation of this method always returns false. Custom TestContext implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method with a more meaningful implementation. Note that the standard TestContext implementation in Spring overrides this method appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现始终返回 `false`。因此，强烈建议自定义的 `TestContext` 实现通过提供更有意义的实现来覆盖此方法。请注意，Spring 中的标准 `TestContext` 实现已适当覆盖了此方法。

items.source: WARNING: This method should only be invoked by the TestContextManager.
items.translation: 警告：此方法仅应由 TestContextManager 调用。

items.source: Concrete implementations are highly encouraged to implement a copy constructor in order to allow the immutable state and attributes of a TestContext to be used as a template for additional contexts created for parallel test execution. The copy constructor must accept a single argument of the type of the concrete implementation. Any implementation that does not provide a copy constructor will likely fail in an environment that executes tests concurrently.
items.translation: 强烈建议具体实现类提供一个 拷贝构造函数，以便将 TestContext 的不可变状态和属性用作模板，为并行测试执行创建额外的上下文。该拷贝构造函数必须接受一个类型为具体实现类的单个参数。任何未提供拷贝构造函数的实现，在并发执行测试的环境中很可能会失败。

items.source: The ApplicationEvent will only be published if the application context for this test context is available.
items.translation: 如果此测试上下文的应用程序上下文可用，才会发布ApplicationEvent。

items.source: By default, this method returns MethodInvoker.DEFAULT_INVOKER.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法返回MethodInvoker.DEFAULT_INVOKER。

items.source: This informs the context cache that the application context can be safely paused if no other test classes are actively using the same application context.
items.translation: 这通知上下文缓存，如果没有其他测试类正在使用相同的应用程序上下文，则可以安全地暂停该应用程序上下文。

items.source: This method is intended to be invoked after execution of the test class has ended and should not be invoked unless the application context for this test context is known to be available.
items.translation: 此方法旨在在测试类执行结束后调用，除非已知此测试上下文的应用程序上下文可用，否则不应调用。

items.source:
Implementations of this method are responsible for loading the
application context if the corresponding context has not already been
loaded, potentially caching the context as well.
items.translation: 此方法的实现负责在相应上下文尚未加载时加载应用程序上下文，并可能缓存该上下文。

items.source: This feature is primarily intended for use within the framework.
items.translation: 此功能主要用于框架内部。

items.source:
Do this if a test has modified the context — for example, by
modifying the state of a singleton bean, modifying the state of an embedded
database, etc.
items.translation: 如果测试修改了上下文（例如，修改了单例 Bean 的状态、嵌入式数据库的状态等），请执行此操作。

items.source:
Caution: concurrent invocations of this method might not be thread-safe,
depending on the underlying implementation.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法的并发调用可能不是线程安全的，具体取决于底层实现。

items.source: By default, this method does nothing.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法不执行任何操作。

items.source: Publish the ApplicationEvent created by the given eventFactory to the application context for this test context.
items.translation: 发布由给定 `eventFactory` 创建的 `ApplicationEvent` 到该测试上下文的 `application context`。

items.source: Get the MethodInvoker to use.
items.translation: 获取要使用的MethodInvoker。

items.source: Get the exception that was thrown during execution of the test method.
items.translation: 获取在测试方法执行期间抛出的异常。

items.source: Call this method to signal that the application context associated with this test context is dirty and should be removed from the context cache.
items.translation: 调用此方法以标记与此测试上下文关联的应用上下文为脏状态，并应从上下文缓存中移除。

items.source: Call this method to signal that the test class is no longer using the application context associated with this test context.
items.translation: 调用此方法以指示测试类不再使用与此测试上下文关联的应用上下文。

items.source: Set the MethodInvoker to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的MethodInvoker。

items.source: Get the application context for this test context, possibly cached.
items.translation: 获取此测试上下文的应用上下文，可能使用缓存。

items.source: Determine if the application context for this test context is known to be available.
items.translation: 确定此测试上下文的应用上下文是否已知可用。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if an error occurs while retrieving the application context
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果在检索应用程序上下文时发生错误

items.source: eventFactory - factory for lazy creation of the ApplicationEvent
items.translation: eventFactory - 用于延迟创建 ApplicationEvent 的工厂

items.source: hierarchyMode - the context cache clearing mode to be applied if the context is part of a hierarchy (may be null)
items.translation: hierarchyMode - 如果上下文属于层次结构，则应用此上下文缓存清除模式（可为 null）

items.source: testInstance - the current test instance (may be null)
items.translation: testInstance - 当前测试实例（可能为 null）

items.source: testMethod - the current test method (may be null)
items.translation: testMethod - 当前测试方法（可能为 null）

items.source: testException - the exception that was thrown in the test method, or null if no exception was thrown
items.translation: testException - 测试方法中抛出的异常，或者如果没有抛出异常则为 null。

items.source: true if the application context has already been loaded
items.translation: true 表示应用程序上下文已经加载。

items.source: the current test instance (never null)
items.translation: 当前测试实例（永远不为null）

items.source: the current test method (never null)
items.translation: 当前测试方法（永远不为null）

items.source: the exception that was thrown, or null if no exception was thrown
items.translation: 抛出的异常，或者如果没有抛出异常则为null

items.source: Get the test class for this test context.
items.translation: 获取此测试上下文的测试类。

items.source: Get the current test instance for this test context.
items.translation: 获取此测试上下文的当前测试实例。

items.source: Get the current test method for this test context.
items.translation: 获取此测试上下文的当前test method。

items.source: Update this test context to reflect the state of the currently executing test.
items.translation: 更新此测试上下文以反映当前正在执行的测试的状态。

items.source: the application context (never null)
items.translation: 应用程序上下文（永远不为null）

items.source: the test class (never null)
items.translation: 测试类（永远不为null）

items.source: Sam Brannen
items.translation: Sam Brannen
